M02_01.title: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

M02_03.title: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much

M02_04.title: Feeling tired or having little energy

M02_06.title: Feeling bad about yourself - or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down

M02_07.title: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television

M02_08.title: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite - being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual

M02_09.title: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

M02_10.title: Over the past 14 days, how much have the difficulties above interfered with work, household responsibilities or relationships?

M02_11.title: Have periods of this kind of low mood occurred several times in your life?

choices.C: I don't know / I'm not sure

M02_12.title: How long did the most recent episode of low mood or loss of pleasure last, or how long has it lasted so far?
M02_12.time: The total duration of the most recent episode described.

choices.A: I have not had an episode like this
choices.C: From 2 weeks to less than 1 month
choices.D: From 1 month to less than 3 months
choices.E: From 3 months to less than 6 months
choices.F: From 6 months to less than 1 year
choices.H: Variable; I cannot give a single duration

M02_13.title: Over the past 14 days, did loss of pleasure persist even in situations you used to enjoy?

choices.C: I don't know / I'm not sure

M02_14.title: On how many days in the past 28 days did you feel emotionally empty?

M02_15.title: How much were you distressed by thoughts that life lacks meaning or purpose?

M02_16.title: How did your mood usually differ in the morning and evening?

choices.A: Worse in the morning, better in the evening
choices.B: Better in the morning, worse in the evening
choices.C: Changed significantly, but without a unified pattern
choices.D: Was relatively similar throughout the day

M02_17.title: How pronounced was the mood difference between morning and evening?

M02_18.title: On how many days did you notice such mood changes throughout the day?

M02_19.title: What do you think caused your mood changes throughout the day?

choices.H: The change was for no reason I could understand.

M02_20.title: Has the depression or loss of joy been present most days for at least two years, even between more severe episodes?

choices.C: I do not know / difficult to say

M02_21.title: Have severe mood difficulties recurred at the same time of year for at least two years?

choices.C: I do not know / difficult to say
